text_block_list.text:
"One winter day, with the sudden snowfall,
the students were all enjoying the snow in their own ways.
Among them, one particular crowd stood out."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! Even as a snow sculpture,
my likeness is truly captivating!

At the center of the crowd, T.M. Opera O appeared to be sculpting a snow statue of herself.
Beside it stood three other statues—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
F-For someone like me... to have Opera O-san
make something for me...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be... is that me standing next to you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then as I thought,
that spot next to you is mine, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I plan to decorate the roof
of the mansion I will build someday with it!
This is the prototype!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: T-That's quite an ambitious plan. But Opera O-chan's statue... compared to ours, how should I put it—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I really think Opera O-chan's statue
is way too over-the-top!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Of course it would prosper!
Just as the meaning of "leading role" implies!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O-chan.
May I fix up my own snow sculpture myself?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I want to stand beside her.
Right next to Opera O-chan. As an equal lead protagonist!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"There is only one protagonist for this glorious statue.
Do not simply line up beside me—come and claim it for yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So it's a match, then.
I gladly accept!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This is a match, after all.
I'll face you with the resolve it deserves!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
The star of the show definitely needs a fitting outfit.
Looking good, Top Road-san!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! That's what makes it
worth my while!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
Honestly, what are they even doing...?"
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to do it too?
Aren't you all going to do it too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
…………
...I'll just go freshen up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The piece that Opera O-san made for me.
I'm very happy... but.
More than that, I... I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I want to... stand side by side with everyone too...!

And so, the four began sculpting their respective snow statues.
One with millimeter precision.
Another desperately trying not to fall behind the one next to her.

Some majestically and delicately.
Others powerfully and boldly.
The spectacle was as if—
It took on the appearance of a race across the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I won't lose... Never...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Great work, everyone!
Thanks to all of you, it turned out to be an absolute masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I just did it on a whim.
I don't care about the rest."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I also... um, just went ahead and did it
on my own, so~... um, sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how does it look?
Our snow sculpture, that is!
choice_data_list: I think it's wonderful as a standalone piece of work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how does it look?
Our snow sculpture, that is!
choice_data_list: I think it's wonderful as a standalone piece of work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Really! Hearing you say that
makes all the hard work worth it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Putting on this outfit to psych myself up
turned out to be the right call, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "I believe it was precisely that fighting spirit that allowed it to take shape so dynamically!"
In truth, the craftsmanship was rather rough around the edges... but minor details aside, everyone seemed satisfied, which is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know what you mean!
Everyone looks so full of life, it's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Even as a piece created by all of us together, I really love this work!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It has that real rival vibe...
I just love that fiery rivalry feeling!

The snow sculpture the four of them built turned out
to evoke a fierce sense of rivalry.
